entries.title: Passed my Ph.D. proposal examination
entries.description: Completed my proposal examination in Computer Engineering at the University of Florida, focusing on fault tolerance and reliable computing.

entries.title: Two of our papers accepted at SC26
entries.description: Our work on reliable large language model inference and compressed scientific I/O was accepted at SC26.

entries.title: Attended SC25 in St. Louis
entries.description: Attended SC25 in St. Louis, Missouri, during the conference held November 16–21, 2025.

entries.title: Completed my master's degree at the University of Iowa
entries.description: Completed my Master of Computer Science at the University of Iowa before beginning my Ph.D. at the University of Florida.

entries.title: Started my Ph.D. in Computer Engineering at the University of Florida
entries.description: Began my Ph.D. in August 2025 and joined the Dependable Systems Lab as a Graduate Research Assistant working with Prof. Guanpeng Li.

entries.title: Joined Argonne National Laboratory as a Visiting Graduate Researcher
entries.description: Started my visiting graduate research appointment at Argonne National Laboratory in June 2025, working with Dr. Sheng Di on scientific data compression and hardware–software co-design.

entries.title: First publication at IEEE SecDev
entries.description: Our collaboration on container security and benchmarking led to Evaluating Container Debloaters at IEEE SecDev 2023, held October 18–20, 2023.

entries.title: Started graduate school and research at the University of Iowa
entries.description: After completing my B.S. at LUMS, began graduate studies at the University of Iowa in August 2023 and started as a Graduate Research Assistant working on fault tolerance and reliable scientific computing.

entries.title: Teaching Assistant for Database Systems at the University of Iowa
entries.description: Supported Database Systems students during the fall 2023 semester, from August through December 2023.

entries.title: Completed my bachelor's degree at LUMS
entries.description: Graduated with a B.S. in Computer Science from Lahore University of Management Sciences.

entries.title: Started a research collaboration with the University of Arizona and SRI International
entries.description: Began collaborating on container security and benchmarking with researchers at LUMS, the University of Arizona, and SRI International (formerly Stanford Research Institute). The collaboration ran from August 2022 through May 2023.

entries.title: Teaching Assistant for Computational Problem Solving at LUMS
entries.description: Supported Computational Problem Solving students during the fall 2022 semester, from August through December 2022.
